verdict.rationale: Phaser Studio ships an official 'Game Agent' MCP server (phaser.io/agent, phaser.io/agent/mcp) that connects to Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot etc. and lets users describe changes in plain language (e.g. 'add a double-jump', 'create a particle emitter, reorganise layers, rename objects'), covering scripting and scene/asset scaffolding tasks with 40+ specialised tools. However this is a separate first-party Editor/Agent product tied to licensing/pricing rather than an assistant embedded in the core open-source engine, there's no explicit evidence it answers general API questions, and there's no independent/community corroboration of its real-world quality (runtime probe confirms it's hosted, not an installable package). Missing for 10: evidence of API-Q&A capability, independent hands-on validation, and confirmation it's not gated behind a paid tier.
